# Fil One Documentation

> Fil One is an S3-compatible object storage platform for teams that need
> reliable, cost-effective storage. Stored on the Filecoin network, where storage providers must
> continuously submit cryptographic proofs that they still hold the data they
> committed to store. No egress fees on paid plans, no per-request charges,
> $5.99/TB/month with a $5.99/month minimum.
> Standard S3 SDKs and tools work once you point them at your region's endpoint,
> `https://s3.<region>.filonecontent.com`, and enable path-style addressing, with
> standard Access Key ID / Secret Access Key auth. Some S3 features are missing
> (see S3 Compatibility). Endpoint, region and key must all refer to the same region.

Critical integration notes for developers:
- CreateBucket and DeleteBucket via the S3 API are region-dependent: supported
  in us-east-1, unavailable in eu-west-1 (use the dashboard there). The dashboard
  can delete a bucket in EVERY region, including eu-west-1, but only for Owner
  and Admin roles and only once the bucket is EMPTY (no objects or versions)
- Path-style addressing required: `https://s3.eu-west-1.filonecontent.com/bucket/key`
  (virtual-hosted-style URLs are not supported)
- Access keys are scoped to ONE region and cannot be used against another
- Region, versioning, Object Lock and retention are fixed at bucket creation and
  cannot be changed afterwards (no update-bucket operation). PutBucketVersioning,
  PutBucketObjectLockConfiguration and Get/PutBucketEncryption CANNOT BE GRANTED
  to any access key in either region; versioning and default retention are set
  only in the console's create form (under Advanced settings)
- Bucket names are unique within the region; names starting with `filone-rag-`
  are reserved
- Authentication: AWS Signature Version 4 (SigV4). In boto3 set
  `Config(signature_version="s3v4")` explicitly so presigned URLs use SigV4
- AWS SDK for JavaScript v3.729+ adds CRC32 checksums by default; set
  `requestChecksumCalculation: "WHEN_REQUIRED"` and
  `responseChecksumValidation: "WHEN_REQUIRED"` on the S3Client, or presigned
  uploads fail with BadDigest
- Credentials: the console's Download .env uses the standard AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID /
  AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY names, which every SDK reads automatically
- All buckets are private by default; all data is encrypted at rest and in
  transit (TLS); encryption cannot be disabled. At-rest encryption is done by the
  regional storage gateway and keys are held by the regional operator, NOT by Fil
  One and NOT customer-managed. Do not name a specific cipher or SSE mode.
  SSE-KMS is rejected in BOTH regions (InvalidRequest in us-east-1; AccessDenied
  or InvalidRequest in eu-west-1). SSE-C is rejected in eu-west-1 and not yet
  confirmed in us-east-1 — send no encryption headers at all. No access key can
  be granted Get/PutBucketEncryption in either region
- Regions: eu-west-1 Europe (France, default) and us-east-1 US East (Michigan)
- Deletion is permanent and immediate on non-versioned buckets (no recycle bin).
  On versioned buckets an S3-API delete WITHOUT a version ID places a delete
  marker and prior versions are retained and still billed. The DASHBOARD NEVER
  WRITES A DELETE MARKER: a console delete (single or bulk) permanently removes
  the specific version on the row chosen, even on a versioned bucket
- CopyObject / server-side copy is confirmed working in us-east-1, including
  copying a specific version onto the current key to promote it (a version
  restore). In eu-west-1 PLAIN COPY WORKS but the version-id form is NOT YET
  CONFIRMED; download and re-upload is the fallback. The dashboard has no restore/roll-back button either way
- Per-object CIDs, deal IDs, and sealing state are NOT exposed — customers
  cannot independently audit an individual object
- A failed payment (past_due) makes the DASHBOARD READ-ONLY from the moment the
  payment fails, not after a later deadline; Stripe retries the charge. An
  organization OWNER can reactivate a canceled or disabled subscription from
  Billing -> Reactivate (no need to contact support)
- Trial caps are enforcement thresholds, not allowances: storage reaching 1 TB
  WRITE-LOCKS the account (lifted on the next usage run once storage is back
  under 1 TB); egress reaching 2 TB DISABLES it entirely, with NO read-only grace
  period first. Trial egress is a single cumulative budget over the 30 days.
  Enforced by a twice-daily job (~07:00/19:00 UTC), not in real time
- Storage is DECIMAL: 1 TB = 1,000 GB, 1 GB = 1,000,000,000 bytes
- Object Lock has NO grantable bypass permission: retention can be set or
  EXTENDED but NEVER SHORTENED, in either mode
- PutObjectRetention (per-object retention) and Legal Hold
  (Get/PutObjectLegalHold) work in BOTH REGIONS, including blocking delete while
  a hold is active. Both need the matching granular key
  permission, which is never granted automatically, and only an organization
  OWNER can create a key with PutObjectRetention or PutObjectLegalHold.
  Evidence differs by region: us-east-1 from the automated compatibility suite,
  eu-west-1 from engineering testing (the suite could not create a lock-enabled
  bucket there)
- The S3 API has NO IAM users, roles, or bucket policies: each request is allowed
  or refused by the access key's own permissions and bucket scope. The CONSOLE
  has organizations with four member roles (Owner, Admin, Member, Read only); a
  key can only carry permissions its creator's role holds
- Access keys can be ROTATED in the dashboard (new Access Key ID and secret,
  same name/permissions/buckets/region/expiry; old secret stops working at once)
- Object/part size limits (5 TB object, 5 GB single-PUT, 10,000 parts, 5 MB min
  part) are standard AWS S3 values, NOT independently confirmed for Fil One
- Bucket names forbid dots (unlike AWS S3); object keys are capped at 1,024
  CHARACTERS for dashboard uploads (code-backed); through the S3 API the standard
  S3 limit of 1,024 bytes applies but is NOT independently confirmed
- In eu-west-1, UNIMPLEMENTED OPERATIONS RETURN AccessDenied (403), NOT
  NotImplemented (501), and a bucket/key you cannot see returns 403 instead of
  404. A 403 from PutBucketPolicy, PutBucketAcl, PutBucketLifecycleConfiguration
  or the tagging operations means the FEATURE IS ABSENT, not that the key lacks
  a permission; PutBucketVersioning and PutBucketEncryption can't be granted to
  any key, so they fail the same way
- ACL requests fail two different ways in eu-west-1: a canned-ACL HEADER on an
  upload (--acl public-read) is SILENTLY IGNORED and the upload SUCCEEDS, while a
  DEDICATED call (Put/GetBucketAcl, Put/GetObjectAcl) is REJECTED with
  AccessDenied. Neither makes an object public
- Error CODES deviate from AWS in eu-west-1 even though the XML format is
  standard: BadDigest->InvalidArgument, InvalidRange->InvalidArgument,
  InvalidTag->BadRequest, BucketAlreadyExists->BucketAlreadyOwnedByYou. Some
  invalid requests are also ACCEPTED where AWS returns 400
- Open eu-west-1 client-affecting bugs: ListObjects NextMarker can carry an
  internal suffix (use ListObjectsV2 + ContinuationToken instead);
  EncodingType=url encodes a space as "+" not "%20"; additional-checksum
  operations are unreliable (ChecksumType may be missing from
  CompleteMultipartUpload responses)

## Getting Started

- [Introduction](https://docs.filone.com/): What Fil One is, who it is for, and
  where to start
- [Quickstart](https://docs.filone.com/quickstart): Create an account (email,
  Google, or GitHub), create a bucket in the console (leave Advanced settings at
  their defaults for a first bucket), create an API key, and upload your first
  object — covers App, AWS CLI (a `filone` profile, not your default one),
  Python, and JavaScript paths
- [Quickstart - AWS CLI](https://docs.filone.com/quickstart/cli): AWS CLI v2.13+
  with a named `filone` profile holding endpoint_url and path-style addressing;
  `my-bucket` throughout; CreateBucket from the CLI only with a us-east-1
  profile (`filone-us`)
- [Quickstart - SDK](https://docs.filone.com/quickstart/sdk): Copy-paste examples
  for Python (boto3), JavaScript (AWS SDK v3, saved as `upload.mjs`), and Go
  (`go mod init` first) that upload and verify; create the bucket in the
  console first. Credentials come from AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID / AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY

## Storage

- [Buckets](https://docs.filone.com/storage/buckets): Naming rules (no dots;
  unique within the region; `filone-rag-` prefix reserved), creating in the
  console (Versioning, Object Lock and Retention under Advanced settings, only at
  creation; Retention starts at 15 days Governance), listing via API, deleting
  (bucket must be EMPTY; console delete works in every region for Owner/Admin
  roles; S3-API DeleteBucket in us-east-1 only), and what happens to deleted data
- [Objects](https://docs.filone.com/storage/objects): Upload, download, list, delete,
  and presigned URLs with code for App, AWS CLI, and boto3. A console delete on a
  versioned bucket PERMANENTLY removes that version (no delete marker), while an
  S3-API delete without a version ID writes a delete marker. A presigned URL is
  a bearer credential until it expires; console Share links last at most 7 days
- [Multipart Uploads](https://docs.filone.com/storage/multipart-uploads): Required
  above the single-PUT ceiling (standard S3 5 GB, not independently confirmed);
  recommended for > 100 MB. Console uploads are single-PUT; multipart is via
  your own SDK/CLI. No lifecycle rule to auto-abort incomplete uploads. Cleanup
  needs List (list uploads) and Write (abort); us-east-1 keys created before
  26 August 2026 lack these multipart actions (403), so replace them
- [Versioning](https://docs.filone.com/storage/versioning): Opt-in at bucket
  creation, cannot be suspended. Overwrites and S3-API deletes without a version
  ID keep earlier versions; deleting a specific version, including any console
  delete, is permanent. Version operations need granular key permissions (List
  object versions, Read object versions, Delete object versions), none granted
  automatically
- [Object Lock](https://docs.filone.com/storage/object-lock): WORM retention.
  Opt-in at bucket creation, Governance (default) and Compliance modes, 1 day to
  100 years. NO grantable bypass permission, so retention can be set or extended
  but NOT SHORTENED in either mode; Compliance retention can't be removed and
  stays billed until it expires. Per-object PutObjectRetention and Legal Hold
  work in both regions; Set retention / Set legal hold are Owner-only to grant.
  NO third-party compliance attestation; regulations such as SEC 17a-4 are
  illustrative use cases, not a certification claim

## Security

- [Account Security](https://docs.filone.com/security/account-security): securing
  the account you sign in with (distinct from API request auth). Sign-in via
  passkeys, Google, GitHub, or email with password; email verification is
  mandatory before the console opens. Opt-in two-factor with three factor types:
  authenticator app (OTP), security key, device biometrics. SMS and email codes
  are deliberately NOT offered. Up to 20 passkeys per account. Single-use
  recovery codes; signing in with one makes you set up a new two-factor method
  in the same sign-in. Removing a factor or passkey, removing all factors, and
  regenerating a recovery code require a session established with 2FA or a
  passkey (step-up). Transferring organization ownership also needs a sign-in
  within the last five minutes
- [Authentication](https://docs.filone.com/security/authentication): SigV4 auth
  setup for AWS CLI, Python (boto3 with signature_version s3v4), JavaScript
  (AWS SDK v3), and Go; credentials from the standard AWS_* environment variables;
  the Access Key ID identifies the key
- [API Keys](https://docs.filone.com/security/api-keys): Creating keys with scoped
  permissions (Read/Write/List/Delete; Read, Write, List and the bucket-config
  reads are pre-selected, so untick Write for read-only keys), single-region
  scoping, bucket-level scoping ("all buckets" means all in the key's region),
  expiry (a key works through the end of the chosen UTC day), ROTATION,
  revocation, handling downloaded .env/.csv files, best practices. Write without
  Delete can still OVERWRITE; multipart uploads need Write. A key is capped at
  its creator's role; removing a member or narrowing a role revokes their keys
  that exceed it, and they are emailed which keys. Names starting with
  `filone-console` are reserved
- [Encryption](https://docs.filone.com/security/encryption): server-side
  encryption always on for all objects; TLS in transit; keys held by the regional
  operator (no customer-managed keys, cipher unconfirmed). SSE-KMS rejected in
  both regions; SSE-C rejected in eu-west-1, not yet confirmed in us-east-1.
  Client-side encryption is up to you — AWS's S3 Encryption Client exists only
  for Java/.NET/Go/Ruby, NOT boto3/CLI/JS v3

## Billing

- [Trial & Billing](https://docs.filone.com/billing/trial): 30-day free trial with
  1 TB storage (1,000 GB) and 2 TB egress (cumulative); starts after EMAIL
  VERIFICATION; ONE TRIAL PER PERSON, on the first organization they own —
  organizations created later have no trial, need a payment method and are
  billed separately with their own $5.99 minimum. Storage cap write-locks, egress
  cap disables the account; S3 uploads can continue up to ~12 hours after the
  trial ends until the twice-daily job applies read-only. A failed payment makes
  the console read-only immediately. An Owner can REACTIVATE from Billing at any
  time, even after the account is disabled (support is only for data removal).
  Invoices are charged automatically to the card on file. Pay as you go
  $5.99/TB/month, $5.99/month minimum, no egress or request fees (earlier
  subscribers keep their $4.99 or per-unit terms); Business plan (1, 3, or 5-year
  terms) via sales. Cancellation is via the Stripe portal, Owners only
- [Pricing](https://docs.filone.com/billing/pricing): Pay as you go $5.99/TB/month
  (decimal TB, 1,000 GB) with a $5.99/month minimum; single linear rate plus a
  floor (no first-TB tier); storage measured as daily readings and averaged, with
  the running average reported twice daily; no egress or per-request charges.
  Organizations that subscribed before the move to $5.99 keep $4.99/TB with a
  $4.99 minimum; accounts predating any minimum have none
- [Usage](https://docs.filone.com/billing/usage): What is measured (average stored
  bytes, egress), which egress figure is which (billing period vs the Dashboard's
  rolling 30 days vs the trial's cumulative total), trial caps and how they are
  enforced; the billing date is the date you upgraded or last reactivated

## API Reference

- [API Reference Overview](https://docs.filone.com/reference/overview): Base endpoint,
  SigV4 authentication requirement, path-style addressing, and response format
- [S3 Compatibility](https://docs.filone.com/reference/s3-compatibility): Full table
  of supported vs. unsupported S3 operations per region (GetObject, PutObject,
  DeleteObject, ListObjectsV2, multipart, presigned URLs supported; bucket
  configuration calls such as PutBucketVersioning, PutBucketObjectLockConfiguration
  and Get/PutBucketEncryption not available to access keys; bucket policies,
  lifecycle rules and IAM users/roles not supported on the S3 API); how
  unsupported operations respond in eu-west-1 (AccessDenied, not
  NotImplemented); known error-code deviations and known issues; the JS SDK
  checksum setting for presigned uploads
- [Error Reference](https://docs.filone.com/reference/errors): Standard S3 XML error
  format, 4xx and 5xx error codes, the ways codes deviate from AWS, console
  errors, and troubleshooting for first-request problems (key used in the wrong
  region, virtual-hosted DNS failures, AccessDenied on delete because Delete is
  not pre-selected, BadDigest on JS presigned uploads, multipart cleanup on old
  us-east-1 keys). Service status: https://status.filone.com
- [Limits & Quotas](https://docs.filone.com/limits): Organization limits (storage,
  egress, buckets per organization, 10 owned organizations, 25 pending
  invitations), object size limits (max 5 TB, multipart above 5 GB; not
  independently confirmed), console limits (5 GB per upload, 50 tags,
  1,000-character description, share links up to 7 days, retention 1 day to 100
  years), API rate limits, and naming constraints (reserved `filone-rag-` bucket
  prefix; object keys 1,024 characters in the console, 1,024 bytes via the API)

## SDKs & Tools

- [SDKs & Tools Overview](https://docs.filone.com/sdk/overview): Connection parameters
  for all tools (endpoint, region, credentials from API Keys in the console; AWS
  CLI v2.13+); recommended tools list including rclone, Cyberduck, s3cmd, MinIO
  Client
- [Python (boto3)](https://docs.filone.com/sdk/python): Full examples for upload,
  download, list, delete, multipart, presigned URLs (signature_version s3v4), and
  error handling; CreateBucket only with a us-east-1 client
- [JavaScript (AWS SDK v3)](https://docs.filone.com/sdk/javascript): Full examples
  for Node.js (ES modules) including streaming downloads, pagination, presigned
  URLs, and error handling; requires `forcePathStyle: true` and, for presigned
  uploads on v3.729+, `requestChecksumCalculation: "WHEN_REQUIRED"`
- [Go (aws-sdk-go-v2)](https://docs.filone.com/sdk/go): Full examples for upload,
  download, paginated listing, presigned URLs, and error handling; requires
  `UsePathStyle: true`; CreateBucket only with a us-east-1 client
- [AWS CLI](https://docs.filone.com/sdk/cli): Installation (v2.13+), named-profile
  configuration, core operations, multipart uploads and cleanup. `aws s3 mb` and
  `aws s3 rb` work in us-east-1 only (shown with a `filone-us` profile); in
  eu-west-1 create and delete buckets in the console (Owner and Admin roles)

## Integrations

- [Integrations](https://docs.fil.one/integrations): Setup guides for common transfer, backup, NAS, DevOps, analytics, and AI tools
- [Integration connection settings](https://docs.fil.one/integrations/connection-settings): Endpoints (https://eu-west-1.s3.fil.one, https://us-east-1.s3.fil.one), region, SigV4, path-style, and credential settings
- [Check a setup](https://docs.fil.one/integrations/validate-an-integration): Optional steps to copy a small fixture, restore it, and compare checksums
- [rclone](https://docs.fil.one/integrations/data-movement/rclone): provider Other, force_path_style, config example, rclone check validation
- [Cyberduck and Mountain Duck](https://docs.fil.one/integrations/data-movement/cyberduck-mountain-duck): bookmark, mount, restore, and troubleshooting guidance
- [AWS CLI and SDKs](https://docs.fil.one/integrations/data-movement/aws-cli-sdk): the reference clients, with setup in the SDK guides
- [Acronis Cyber Protect](https://docs.fil.one/integrations/backup/acronis-cyber-protect): S3-compatible storage, backup, restore, and integrity validation
- [Comet Backup](https://docs.fil.one/integrations/backup/comet-backup): Storage Vault setup and restore validation
- [MSP360](https://docs.fil.one/integrations/backup/msp360): S3-compatible storage account and recovery workflow
- [NAKIVO Backup and Replication](https://docs.fil.one/integrations/backup/nakivo): repository, recovery, and verification guidance
- [Synology Cloud Sync](https://docs.fil.one/integrations/nas/synology-cloud-sync): custom S3 task and download recovery
- [QNAP HBS](https://docs.fil.one/integrations/nas/qnap-hbs): HBS storage space, backup, and restore
- [TrueNAS Cloud Sync](https://docs.fil.one/integrations/nas/truenas-cloud-sync): credential, push, pull, and integrity workflow
- [Velero](https://docs.fil.one/integrations/devops/velero): Kubernetes backup, restore, and volume-scope validation
- [Harbor](https://docs.fil.one/integrations/devops/harbor): registry push, pull, digest, and garbage-collection guidance
- [Terraform S3 backend](https://docs.fil.one/integrations/devops/terraform): endpoints and use_path_style backend settings, state migration, recovery, and concurrency validation
- [Elasticsearch searchable snapshots](https://docs.fil.one/integrations/logging/elasticsearch-snapshots): s3 repository client settings, repository verification, restore, and searchable-snapshot validation
- [Splunk SmartStore](https://docs.fil.one/integrations/logging/splunk-smartstore): remote storage, eviction, search, and recovery validation
- [Apache Iceberg](https://docs.fil.one/integrations/data-ai/apache-iceberg): S3FileIO, catalog, commits, and recovery validation
- [Databricks](https://docs.fil.one/integrations/data-ai/databricks): custom-endpoint compute, read, write, and fresh-cluster recovery
- [Delta Lake](https://docs.fil.one/integrations/data-ai/delta-lake): transaction log, checkpoints, concurrency, and recovery
- [DuckDB](https://docs.fil.one/integrations/data-ai/duckdb): httpfs read, write, and cache-independent validation
- [Hugging Face Datasets](https://docs.fil.one/integrations/data-ai/hugging-face-datasets): load, streaming, cache clearing, and package-version guidance
- [Ray Data](https://docs.fil.one/integrations/data-ai/ray-data): distributed reads, writes, worker configuration, and retry validation

## Console

The browser console at app.filone.com, one page per console screen. No code
required. Each page below is console-specific; the capability pages (Storage,
Security, Billing) hold the concepts and code samples.

- [App - Dashboard](https://docs.filone.com/app/dashboard): Console home. A new
  organization opens on a Get started page (/get-started) with Create bucket and
  Create API key. A dismissible Free trial banner shows days left and Upgrade.
  PLAN/STORAGE/EGRESS cards (PLAN shown to Owner/Admin only), Usage Trends,
  Recent Activity. Storage is a periodic point-in-time reading and egress is a
  rolling 30-day total, not a calendar month. "Est. monthly cost" applies your
  plan's per-TB price to the latest reading with the monthly minimum as the
  floor, while the invoice uses AVERAGE storage, so they differ
- [App - Buckets](https://docs.filone.com/app/buckets): Bucket list, create form
  (name unique in the region; Versioning, Object Lock and Retention under a
  collapsed Advanced settings with "Needs Versioning" / "Needs Object Lock"
  badges; only a Create bucket button; the new bucket's page then offers Create
  API key), object browser, upload, object detail, download/share, delete.
  DELETE BUCKET: Owner/Admin only, EMPTY buckets only, works in EVERY region.
  EMPTY BUCKET permanently deletes every object, version and delete marker not
  under retention or legal hold and cannot be undone. A console delete on a
  versioned bucket PERMANENTLY deletes the chosen version (NO delete marker).
  Name, region, versioning, Object Lock and default retention are PERMANENT at
  creation. Upload is single-PUT (5 GB ceiling); the browser shows the first
  ~1,000 entries; no version restore/promote. Download works on trial; SHARING IS
  A PAID-PLAN FEATURE (links of 1 hour to 7 days)
- [App - API Keys](https://docs.filone.com/app/api-keys): Key list (Status Active
  or Expired; Permissions as Read/Write/List/Delete badges plus +n; search and
  region/status filters from 5 keys; a row opens a details panel with expiry,
  region, buckets and full permissions; multi-select bulk delete) and create
  flow. Region is REQUIRED and a key works only against its own region's
  endpoint. Read/Write/List and the bucket-config reads pre-selected, Delete NOT;
  retention, legal hold and version permissions are granted INDIVIDUALLY.
  "Create bucket"/"Delete bucket" unavailable in eu-west-1. Role ceiling: Read
  only cannot create keys, Members manage only their own, Admins/Owners manage
  all; Set retention/Set legal hold are Owner-only. Secret shown ONCE (at
  creation or rotation); downloaded .env/.csv files hold it in plain text, so
  delete them and never commit them. ROTATE keeps name, permissions, buckets,
  region and expiry; the old secret stops working at once. Deleting a key is the
  revocation and breaks any application using it immediately
- [App - AI Agent Toolkit](https://docs.filone.com/app/ai-agent-toolkit): NOT
  RELEASED. A "Coming Soon" page with a waitlist form. What works today:
  ordinary S3 access keys scoped to a bucket, which is how LangChain, LlamaIndex,
  Vercel AI SDK and CrewAI connect
- [App - Organization](https://docs.filone.com/app/organization): Every account
  starts as a one-person organization with you as Owner. Members, Billing and
  Audit log are in the left sidebar's Organization group; the organization menu
  at the top holds Edit organization, your organizations, and Create
  organization (any role; up to 10 owned; a new organization has no free trial,
  needs a payment method and is billed separately). Four roles: Owner, Admin,
  Member, Read only. Only Owners manage billing, transfer ownership, or grant
  Set retention / Set legal hold; Owners and Admins invite, change roles, remove
  members, rename the org, and delete buckets. Roles apply in the console; the S3
  API has no users or roles, and a key is capped at its creator's role. Narrowing
  a role or removing a member REVOKES their keys that exceed it, and they are
  emailed which keys. At least one Owner always; transfer makes you Admin and
  needs a sign-in within five minutes. Invitations: single-use links, expire in
  14 days, max 25 pending. Audit log kept 90 days, CSV export up to 20,000 rows.
  Deleting an organization is not available in the console yet
  (support@filone.com)
- [App - Billing](https://docs.filone.com/app/billing): Plan card, usage card,
  payment method, choosing a plan, invoices, "Need help?" panel, opened from the
  sidebar's Organization group. Visible to Owners and Admins; every action is
  Owner-only. During the trial the status badge reads Active with plan Free
  trial; manually billed organizations show Billed manually or Custom plan. A
  FAILED PAYMENT makes the console read-only. An Owner can Reactivate a canceled
  subscription ("Your data is still here"). "Choose your plan": Pay as you go
  ($5.99/TB/month, $5.99 minimum) or Business plan (custom pricing, 1, 3, or
  5-year terms). Invoices list shows the 12 most recent issued invoices,
  INCLUDING UNPAID. Card details and cancellation (Owners only) live in the
  Stripe portal
- [App - Settings](https://docs.filone.com/app/settings): Profile card with Avatar,
  Name (autosaves when you leave the field) and Email (changed through a Change
  email dialog; changing it RESETS VERIFICATION); Google/GitHub sign-ins manage
  these at the provider. Organizations section to switch or leave
  organizations, notification preferences (Marketing emails only), pointer to
  Account Security. "Delete account" is not available in the console yet: email
  support@filone.com
- [App - Support](https://docs.filone.com/app/support): The Support page, opened
  from Support at the bottom of the left sidebar. Category (Product issue,
  Billing issue, General inquiry, Feature request) and Message; your name,
  organization and email come from your account, and the reply goes to your
  account email. Send message; ~1 business day response. Common questions and a
  Report a bug link. Sales: "Contact sales team" in the "Choose your plan" dialog,
  or "Talk to sales" in Billing's "Need help?" panel on trial/no plan

## Optional

- [FAQ](https://docs.filone.com/faq): Common questions on S3 compatibility (needs
  the endpoint and path-style addressing), blockchain/crypto requirements, data
  residency, deletion behavior, migration from AWS S3, backups, durability (no
  published figure; public 99.9% uptime SLA at https://www.filone.com/sla),
  multiple users (organizations and roles), and Filecoin data integrity mechanics
